notes: A made-up class (the coins of the Ostrel find) under a real one (the 1344 Edward III florin, three known). Could it exist unrecorded (README, Insert)? Yes: a newly reported find of a rare coin adds to its "known" count without falsifying anything documented. The class (the coins of the find) is made up; the find is not empty, as the word says. Determinate: new members named in the prompt (face value; dated before the Black Death). Indeterminate: the known count (README, Insert: subject); the second query gives the size of the find in the prompt so both worlds have a concrete number. A replaced draft (a new 25-cent euro coin) broke the "could it exist unrecorded" rule. Since 2026-10-31 (formal check, FINDINGS A2) 'more than three known?' is tagged fol with arithmetic: it compares a count with three.
